period_ticks.source: Monthly assessment candidate: 30 days at two half-day ticks per day, following GDD monthly responsibility.

base_cash_due.source: Explicit bounded author candidate, equal to one original 8-person household wage installment (8 x rate1), not a claimed fixed GDD tax rate. Actual money remains limited by household funds and reservations.

grain_share_bp.source: Original existing production is public-owned; no private producer is fabricated or relabelled to obtain taxable grain.

civilian_grain_reserve.source: One original cohort.city ration installment, based on real 8 people and rate1.

normal_recovery_bp.source: Explicit development parameter already documented: +1 percentage point toward 100% after a normal period, bounded0..300. GDD does not fix this recovery speed.
